members.name: PawSharp.Interactions.WebhookVerifier
members.summary:
Verifies Discord interaction webhook signatures (X-Signature-Ed25519 /
             X-Signature-Timestamp headers) per the Discord HTTP Interactions spec.
            
             Discord signs each HTTP interaction request using Ed25519. The message that
             is signed is the concatenation of the raw timestamp header value and the raw
             request body bytes.  A request is valid only when:
               1. The X-Signature-Timestamp is not older than 5 minutes (replay protection).
               2. The Ed25519 signature covers timestamp_bytes || body_bytes and
                  verifies against the application's Ed25519 public key shown in the
                  Developer Portal.
            
             Usage:
             
             var verifier = new WebhookVerifier("your_application_public_key_hex");
             bool valid = verifier.Verify(signatureHeader, timestampHeader, requestBodyBytes);
             if (!valid) { return Results.Unauthorized(); }
             
            
             The Ed25519 verification is implemented using 
             arithmetic for full portability across platforms without adding NuGet dependencies.
             For high-throughput scenarios consider replacing the inner
              method with a native binding (e.g. NSec.Cryptography).

params.name: publicKeyHex
params.description:
The application's Ed25519 public key in lower-case hex (64 hex chars / 32 bytes).
            Found in the Discord Developer Portal → Application → General Information.

members.name: PawSharp.Interactions.WebhookVerifier.Verify(System.String,System.String,System.ReadOnlySpan{System.Byte})
members.summary: Verifies an incoming Discord interaction webhook request.
members.returns: if the signature is valid and the timestamp is fresh.

params.name: signatureHex
params.description: Value of the X-Signature-Ed25519 header (128 hex chars).

params.name: timestamp
params.description: Value of the X-Signature-Timestamp header.

params.name: bodyBytes
params.description: Raw request body bytes.

members.name: PawSharp.Interactions.WebhookVerifier.Verify(System.String,System.String,System.String)
members.summary: Convenience overload accepting the body as a UTF-8 string.
